 fd=os.open(DEST,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o700)
 with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:f.write(new.encode());f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())

 SRC.unlink()
 out.update({'status':'RELOCATED_VERIFIED','moved':True,'destination':str(DEST),'old_path_absent':not SRC.exists(),'source_backup_within_project':True,'services_active':True})

print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
